verdict.comment: Course specialist THIS YEARS LOVE has dropped to his last winning mark and looks the one to be on here. Homeland is second choice.

comments.berkshirephantom: Has five wins to his name but hasn't made the frame in nine starts this year.
comments.havachoc: Placed for the first time when third of eight at Carlisle in May; stable debut.
comments.heartened: Nine-race maiden who finished third to Quirke On Parole over C&D three weeks ago.
comments.highwaygrey: 9yo who has been a grand servant to the yard with nine wins but not so good as he was.
comments.homeland: Seven-race maiden but has been placed in three of his last four starts; should go close.
comments.jackandrea: Regressive maiden who has failed to make the frame on all five starts this year.
comments.kaaress: Won at Redcar in May 2024 off 11lb higher mark but has been on the downgrade since.
comments.quirkeonparole: Got off the mark when all out to win over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago.
comments.thisyearslove: All three wins have been here, the last of those over C&D last August off today's mark.
comments.timetellsall: Maiden who has dropped to a career-low mark but may need to go back up in trip to win.

races.raceComment: thisyearslove is marginally preferred with a score of 55.6%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over kaaress. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 11 starts in similar conditions, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Lastchancezouloon is second choice, with DR RIO selected to add to his four course wins. He's been in good form here this year.

comments.carolusmagnus: Both of his wins came at Newmarket in 2021; below his best when last seen; best watched
comments.drrio: Four-time course winner; good run in a seller here last time; may have this run to suit
comments.evocativespark: C&D winner in 2022; yet to shine in five starts for this yard; first start since January
comments.kingsharja: Dual C&D winner last summer; didn't run badly last time but yet to win above class 6 level
comments.kracking: Front-runner; made all at Brighton in April off 5lb lower than today; third there latest
comments.lastchancezouloon: Posted an improved effort on handicap debut at Carlisle (7f); quicker ground today
comments.parkstreet: Hit the frame in this race the last two years; holds e-w claims from a career-low mark
comments.saisonsdor: Won at Southwell in May and ran respectably at Thirsk last time; C&D winner and has claims
comments.sunnyorange: Notched his second C&D win 11 days ago (good to firm); up 3lb and back up in grade
comments.superhit: Won at Thirsk in April but he's failed to beat a rival home in his last two starts

races.raceComment: sunnyorange is marginally preferred with a score of 50.1%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form and more progressive over kracking. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: C&D winner CRYPTOS DREAM posted a solid effort at Yarmouth last time and she's the selection, with The Pug second choice.

comments.bandello: 0-14; wasn't beaten far at Wolverhampton last month but he was below his best last time
comments.cryptosdream: Won a C&D handicap last June; posted a solid effort in this grade at Yarmouth last time
comments.inspiringspeeches: 0-19; respectable efforts in three starts at Beverley for this stable; drops in grade
comments.jesterqueen: Unplaced all seven starts; back down in trip having been well beaten over 1m6f last time
comments.maruna: Sole win came in November 2023; held when fourth in this grade at Lingfield 27 days ago
comments.mond: Beaten a length at Lingfield last month but he was well beaten at Yarmouth last time
comments.mrtrick: Last win came in December 2023; below his best when favourite at Lingfield 27 days ago
comments.recobella: 0-9 in France; beat only one rival home at Haydock on British debut; drops in class
comments.sassyglory: Ran respectably at Doncaster last time but she's yet to win after 18 starts; back in trip
comments.thepug: Three-time AW winner; wasn't beaten far when fourth at Leicester last time; drops in grade
comments.usgrant: 0-7; beaten 3l at Newcastle in April but he failed to build on that back on turf latest

races.raceComment: cryptosdream is marginally preferred with a score of 47.7%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over inspiringspeeches. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good To Firm) looks ideal with 3 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The manner in which OICHE RUA (nap) picked up to deny Spanish Temptress at Limerick on Saturday suggests she's one to follow.

comments.academe: No improvement for the visor when fourth at Bellewstown (1m, good) but ran okay
comments.jasmineaffanalis: Didn't get the clearest of runs when fifth in Oiche Rua's race at Limerick on Saturday
comments.lahoredaking: Well beaten in his maidens but entitled to be more competitive now handicapping
comments.midnightstagger: Won over 7f on AW off this mark and wasn't beaten all that far back at Dundalk afterwards
comments.oicherua: Penalised for Limerick three days ago but was nicely on top at the finish
comments.shahadaace: Well held the last twice in races won by Oiche Rua; looks vulnerable again
comments.spanishtemptress: Second to Oiche Rua on Saturday's handicap debut and has a 7lb pull on the winner
comments.starallure: Is 0-8; appeared to run well in a classified race at Ayr last time
comments.vovatia: Will need to run better than she did on Saturday when behind some of these at Limerick

races.raceComment: oicherua is confidently preferred with a score of 42.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over spanishtemptress. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Yielding To Soft ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 2/6 at killarney-. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Handicap debutante DENIM AND DIAMONDS rocketed home in a maiden last time and she didn't beat rubbish.

comments.anniesangel: Maiden winner (heavy) who ran well behind Shaool on handicap debut at Leopardstown
comments.daboya: Maiden winner; well held in three runs for current yard and this is competitive
comments.denimanddiamonds: Didn't beat rubbish at Limerick (1m4f, good) and she won that maiden by some 11l
comments.elanaosario: Clear of the rest when just failing to reel in an improving filly at Ballinrobe (1m5f)
comments.ladyo: Easing ground would be a help as she won a nursery last year on soft
comments.letiza: Down Royal winner and effectively 4lb lower here with Adam Grant taking away 10lb

races.drawBiasExplanation: High draws favored in sprints on straight course

verdict.comment: One More Bottle holds strong claims under a penalty but THE KAMIKAZE KING went close last time and this could be his day.

comments.arranmore: Not at his best on last two starts; losing run stretches back to August 2021
comments.aurorasdoublesix: Poor form in six starts over sprint trips; step up to 1m not enough to tempt
comments.calcuttadream: Ran well tried in blinkers at Newcastle 19 days ago; danger to all if headgear works again
comments.doctordauila: Second on handicap debut in May but took a backwards step dropped to this grade latest
comments.freepic: Hopes rest on the step up in trip sparking some improvement
comments.myfriendcharles: Little solid form and the new cheekpieces need to give him a big lift
comments.obeejo: Not found his best in 2025 but drops in grade and the forecast rain will be in his favour
comments.onemorebottle: Off mark in a similar race at Ayr last week (1m, good to soft); key player despite penalty
comments.selbysjoy: 15-race maiden who has finished out the back in three runs this summer; no appeal
comments.spiritofmurray: Drop in trip needs to prompt improvement; not solid but may yet do better
comments.thekamikazeking: Went close at Brighton two weeks ago (1m, good to firm); solid claims with a repeat
comments.yorkshireglory: 11-race maiden but he's been banging at the door and ties in closely with One More Bottle

races.raceComment: onemorebottle is marginally preferred with a score of 47.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form over arranmore. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for DASH POWER whose record at this level reads 722122, the latest second having been franked.

comments.adayinbloom: Has failed to beat a rival in all four starts; no appeal
comments.angelofthebay: 0-17 but ran well last time when shaping as though worth another go at 1m
comments.blackanddeckers: Well held in three starts at around 7f since May; worth a market check down at this level
comments.brotherdave: Did well on the AW early last year, but his turf form is nothing like as good
comments.dashpower: Record at this level reads 722122; latest form boosted; major player back in this company
comments.harrypalmer: 0-10 but placed in last two starts as when second at Beverley ten days ago; major player
comments.mavetheforcebewivu: Drops to this level for the first time, but will need to settle better than last time
comments.oselton: Well held in all eight starts; drop in grade and application of a hood not enough to tempt
comments.pendingappeal: Ran well on reappearance in March, but hasn't built on it twice since; needs a resurgence
comments.starshot: 0-30 but has made the frame several times; yard fields a stronger candidate in Dash Power
comments.treblewinners: Third at Redcar a year ago, but poor in five outings since; tongue-tie on
comments.twilightjazz: Last in three starts since returning; Paul Mulrennan 1-1 for stable in past five seasons

races.raceComment: dashpower is marginally preferred with a score of 43.1%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and superior course form over angelofthebay. races.drawBiasExplanation: High draws favored in sprints on straight course

verdict.comment: Slight preference is for DUMFRIES who has been in good form over this trip on fast ground this year.

comments.bazball: Hasn't built on a promising stable debut in January; off three months; had wind surgery
comments.causinacommotion: Beaten a long way on stable debut at Ayr nine days ago; look elsewhere
comments.dumfries: Record over 7f on good to firm ground this year reads 114; major player despite wide draw
comments.fileybeach: 0-10; makes his stable debut after seven months off; market should be informative
comments.goodkarma: 0-16 in handicaps since despite a plummeting mark; plenty to prove after 190 days off
comments.kalganov: Running well before a lesser effort last time; losing run up to 18; others preferred
comments.korroor: Back off last winning mark, but drawn widest and a few of the others hold stronger claims
comments.langholm: Hard to win with, but not far behind Without Delay last time; each-way claims once again
comments.lovegames: Placed a couple of times since handicapping, but not so good last time; has a bit to prove
comments.myhoneyb: Much more out than in since latest success; of interest if backed
comments.ravensbourne: 3lb lower than for sole success at Chelmsford in January; not matched that form since
comments.tootsie: Some promise on her Southwell debut last October, but modest in four starts on turf since
comments.withoutdelay: Only 1lb higher than when winning at Catterick six days ago; very much respected

races.raceComment: langholm is marginally preferred with a score of 53.0%, holding clear edges in superior course form over withoutdelay. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.
